finding: Level-band picker: a Dice100 roll gives an 80 percent window of plus or minus 3 around the player level, a 15 percent window from index 0 up to level plus 1, and a 5 percent tail to the top; one uniform pick from a 20-entry list chosen per place (45 live tables). RandomEncounters.cs lines 1334 to 1526.

Spawn cadence: one roll per elapsed game minute, only in 12 of every 144 game minutes; 1-in-36 outdoors by day, 1-in-24 outdoors by night and in town at night; dungeons roll only while resting and alerted. At the default 12x clock this is about 1.4 (day) to 2.0 (night) outdoor spawns per real hour (computed, not measured). PlayerEntity.cs 491 to 620, FormulaHelper.cs 1765 to 1813.

Alert as heat: raised while the enemy targeting the player can see him, dropped only when that enemy dies, decays after 480 game minutes; while alerted, dungeon rest rolls 1-in-36 per minute. Enemy kill and alert code in EnemySenses.cs 534-535 and EnemyDeath.cs 135-136.

Quest spawn grammar as data: create foe SYMBOL every N minutes M times with P percent success (235 lines; 10 with every 0 minutes). The ambush is four foes at zero interval (M0B21Y19.txt line 232); escort is a HUD portrait, repute +15 or -10 and a completion flag (M0B00Y16.txt lines 219 to 231). CreateFoe.cs lines 47, 77, 115, 137.

Out-of-view placement: the spawn ray starts at the camera view angle plus 0 to 4 degrees, then wall separation, floor probe and an empty sphere test; retried each frame with no cap, and the angle uses the vertical field of view (a donor defect for a portrait phone). FoeSpawner.cs 122 to 197; the same method is written out again from CreateFoe.cs line 260.

City guard response: low legal standing rolls 5 percent per game minute; after a crime, guard NPCs within 77.5 units are switched off and replaced by guards, a non-guard citizen may become one at 1-in-4, with a fallback of 2 to 5 guards at 12.8 to 51.2 units; active guards capped at 5. PlayerEntity.cs 500 to 691.

Encounter record and level: each encounter is a (count, id, level) record; working level is min(L+1, 20) plus 0 to 3, a folded bounded dice roll peaks at L, a main-quest floor and a new-game cap; each level selects one of two groups by coin. ArenaEntityUtils.cpp 1175 to 1225. Chances and tables live in the user's exe, not in the box.

When rolls happen: outdoors one roll per in-game hour (13 game seconds per real second), dungeons one per in-game minute unless camping, town one per minute at night with no citizens near; camping runs the clock at 600x so each hour is a roll (about 0.46 real seconds apiece) and an enemy near ends the rest with a popup. ArenaEntityUtils.cpp 1015 to 1035, GameState.cpp 1240 to 1330.

Placement is close (about -4 to +3 voxels per member). The occupancy and floor checks in the spawn search are commented out (1257 to 1265), and a member on a bad voxel is skipped silently (GameState.cpp 895), so groups can arrive smaller than rolled. Donor defect: keep the close spawn, restore the check in the 40-try loop, and return the spawned count. Terrain is hard-coded to 0 (GameState.cpp 1311).

Guard response: 1 to 3 guards (ArenaEntityUtils.cpp 959); the first to arrive plays Halt for violence or StopThief otherwise (GameState.cpp 934 to 937). Maximum group size matches our MAX_ATTACKERS of 3.
